added_failures_note: Derived from completed source baseline_suite and after_suite logs: both zero FAILED ids and EXIT=0; head failures minus baseline failures is empty. Partition execution remains a blocking evidence defect.

assertion_analysis.180: Removing promotion.py:591 restores exit 1 instead of 0, demonstrated by negative-control.log.
assertion_analysis.181: Returning success without unlinking the ended pointer fails the independent filesystem absence assertion.
assertion_analysis.182-184: Deleting the run receipt during cleanup fails the independent receipt-preservation assertion.
assertion_analysis.207: Treating every newer attempt as ended lets the live case succeed and fails the nonzero-exit assertion.
assertion_analysis.208: Replacing the refusal with an unrelated failure removes the required message and fails this assertion.
assertion_analysis.209: Naming the original attempt rather than the newer pointer attempt fails the output identity assertion.
assertion_analysis.210: Removing launcher naming or substituting supervisor pid fails the actual child-launcher pid output assertion, demonstrated by the negative control.
assertion_analysis.211: Unlinking a live pointer before refusing fails the independent filesystem existence assertion.
assertion_analysis.45,47: Fails if a fixture-id pointer preexists or leaks to actual home; external-state dependency is recorded as a finding.

assertion_independence: No vacuous same-variable assertion found: attempt and launcher fixture inputs name expected identity, but the CLI must independently read and format it; restoring base demonstrates failure of the launcher assertion.
call_sites: reckon/crew/promotion.py:complete (cleanup calls at reviewed-head lines 2005 and 2696)

findings.text: blocking: the baseline_suite and after_suite receipts come from direct pytest tool commands in stream.jsonl on the worker allocation named in prompt.txt:42, with no all_debug sbatch launch; rerun the matched importer arms as the done_when requires before accepting this evidence.

blocking: tests contains an unrecorded truncated pytest invocation with stderr discarded before the actual gate, while measurement_module at :15 is a truncated path plus shell redirection; replace these with the literal recorded gate command and actual imported module path so delivery can be audited and replayed.

non-blocking: _attempt_reservation duplicates the parse-and-type-check capability owned by reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2525 (_read_reservation), adding run-id validation without extending or wrapping that owner; route the read through the owner to keep one reservation parser.

non-blocking: REAL_LIVE and the autouse assertions at :45 and :47 read the actual home crew directory, so the test depends on machine state despite the repository rule requiring isolation under the temporary crew home.
